# Alexander Kolisch — full profile

> Complete text version of alexanderkolisch.com for language models and AI assistants. Short version: https://alexanderkolisch.com/llms.txt. The website is bilingual; German is the leading language, the English text is a 1:1 translation. A German section follows at the end.

## Identity

- Full name: Alexander Kolisch
- Current roles: Co-Founder & Managing Partner, advise by Webmatch (since 09/2026); Director E-Commerce and Marketing, Polo Motorrad und Sportswear GmbH (since 08/2024)
- Location: Düsseldorf, Germany
- Website: https://alexanderkolisch.com
- About page (biography): https://alexanderkolisch.com/about/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexanderkolisch/
- Languages: German (native), English (fluent), Spanish (good)

## Biography

Alexander Kolisch is Director of E-Commerce and Marketing at Polo Motorrad und Sportswear in Düsseldorf, Germany. He is responsible for e-commerce, marketing, CRM, loyalty, and customer service, reporting directly to the CEO and shareholders.

Since September 2026, Alexander Kolisch is Co-Founder and Managing Partner of advise by Webmatch, a joint venture with Webmatch GmbH and thus part of the Friends Digital Group. advise supports management and digital leaders like a digital advisory board, with focus areas in e-commerce, marketplaces, data, AI and organization.

His career spans more than 20 years in e-commerce, omnichannel retail, marketing, and digital transformation. He served as Chief Digital Officer at the Positec Group (WORX) in Cologne and Suzhou, as Director of E-Commerce, Marketing, and Digital at SEVERIN Elektrogeräte in Sundern, and as Head of Digital at Thalia Bücher in Berlin and Münster — the largest bookseller in the German-speaking region. At Bertelsmann, he worked as Director of Corporate Development, driving corporate strategy and digital transformation.

Alexander Kolisch has entrepreneurial experience as a founder and managing director. He founded the music streaming service steereo, funded by Holtzbrinck Ventures (now HV Capital), with a successful trade sale in 2011. He also founded the eHealth project Sporttsclub, supported by the Allianz Digital Accelerator. On the investor side, he served as Investment Manager at Holtzbrinck Ventures, one of Europe's largest early-stage venture funds with investments in companies such as Zalando, Delivery Hero, HelloFresh, and Flixbus.

His career began at ProSiebenSat.1, where he helped build and launch maxdome — Germany's first major video-on-demand platform. He then served as Manager Digital Experience at EMI Music Germany, leading the label's digital strategy.

Alexander Kolisch holds a Diploma in Business Engineering (Diplom-Wirtschaftsingenieur) from Hochschule der Medien (HdM) Stuttgart and an MBA from ESADE Business School in Barcelona — one of the world's leading business schools, ranked 7th in the Financial Times Global MBA Ranking, with triple-crown accreditation (AACSB, EQUIS, AMBA).

His core competencies include e-commerce strategy, omnichannel retail, digital transformation in mid-sized companies, CRM and loyalty programs, performance marketing, marketplace strategy (Amazon, eBay, Kaufland), PIM/DAM implementation, data-driven management with OKR and KPI frameworks, and building and leading high-performing teams in marketing and e-commerce.

He volunteers with GuteNachtBus Düsseldorf, a project providing warm meals, drinks, and conversation to homeless people in Düsseldorf.

Alexander Kolisch speaks German (native), English (fluent), and Spanish (good).

## Career stations

### advise by Webmatch (joint venture with Webmatch GmbH) — Co-Founder & Managing Partner

- Period: 09/2026–present
- Location: Cologne/Düsseldorf
- Website: https://www.webmatch-advise.de

advise by Webmatch helps companies make digital initiatives deliver results: with sparring, context and an outside view, like a digital advisory board at the management table. Focus areas are e-commerce, marketplaces, data, AI and the organization behind them, measured with its own methodology of advise Score, Kompass and Radar. advise is part of Webmatch GmbH and thus of the Friends Digital Group.

### Polo Motorrad und Sportswear GmbH — Director E-Commerce and Marketing

- Period: 08/2024–present
- Location: Jüchen/Düsseldorf
- Website: https://www.polo-motorrad.com

Responsibility for e-commerce, marketing, CRM and loyalty as well as customer service at one of the leading omnichannel retailers in the motorcycle industry. Reporting line to the CEO and shareholders, leading a division of around 40 employees. Focus areas: further development of the web shop, CRM and loyalty program, and expansion of the marketplace business. Also topics such as product data, automation and the organization of customer service.

### SEVERIN Elektrogeräte GmbH — Director Marketing, Digital & E-Commerce

- Period: 01/2021–07/2024
- Location: Sundern
- Website: https://www.severin.com

Responsibility for e-commerce, marketing budgets and P&L, reporting to the CEO and shareholders. International rollout of PIM, DAM and Microsoft Teams, carve-out of D2C logistics, and a realignment of corporate identity and brand presence. Also a globally structured B2B and D2C strategy from Amazon Pan-EU and bol.com in the Netherlands to JD.com and Tmall in China, including the relaunch of the company's own EU web shop.

### POSITEC Group (WORX) — Chief Digital Officer

- Period: 08/2017–12/2020
- Location: Cologne/Suzhou
- Website: https://www.worx.com

As Chief Digital Officer, responsible for the digital transformation of the power tools and robotics manufacturer with more than 4,000 employees, reporting to the owner and CEO. Pan-European e-commerce strategy for Amazon, own platforms and retail partners, plus digital products such as websites, apps and voice applications. Global rollout of PIM and DAM, agile methods with Scrum and Kanban, and leadership of the GDPR program as the EU contact.

### Thalia Bücher GmbH — Head of Digital

- Period: 04/2015–07/2017
- Location: Berlin/Münster
- Website: https://www.thalia.de

Head of Digital at the largest bookseller in the DACH region, with teams in Münster and Berlin. Managed the tolino alliance at executive level, including its restructuring with Kobo/Rakuten as technology partner in place of Deutsche Telekom, from first talks to closing. Product responsibility for the tolino e-reader family with four device launches between 2015 and 2016, and for audiobook and e-book subscriptions.

### Sporttsclub + fitback (Allianz Digital Accelerator) — Founder and Managing Director

- Period: 01/2014–12/2016

Founded an eHealth project funded through the Allianz Digital Accelerator with a six-figure investment. MVP built with nearshore development, presented at Demo Day at Allianz headquarters in Munich, and pivoted to “fitback”, a loyalty program for fitness clubs, field-tested in 2015.

### Bertelsmann SE — Director Corporate Development

- Period: 07/2012–01/2014
- Location: Gütersloh/Berlin
- Website: https://www.bertelsmann.com

Director Corporate Development on the staff of the Board Member for Corporate Development and New Businesses. Contributed to the group's digital strategy and to evaluating and executing deals, focused on EdTech, classifieds and marketplaces.

### steereo (trade sale 2011) — Founder, Managing Director and Shareholder

- Period: 11/2008–01/2011

Founder, managing director and shareholder of a mobile music streaming service with free and subscription tiers, funded with a seven-figure investment from Holtzbrinck Ventures. Licensing with major and independent labels and collecting societies, and a successful trade sale to a strategic buyer in 2011.

### Holtzbrinck Ventures (now HV Capital) — Investment Manager

- Period: 04/2008–11/2008
- Location: Munich
- Website: https://www.hvcapital.com

Investment Manager at one of Europe's largest early-stage funds (now HV Capital). Evaluated investments, conducted due diligence and supported founding teams.

### EMI Music Germany — Manager Digital Experience

- Period: 12/2007–04/2008
- Location: Cologne

Assessed digital maturity and developed strategic recommendations for a 360-degree model. Implemented new digital business initiatives, such as placing EMI artists like Iron Maiden in “Guitar Hero”.

### ProSiebenSat.1 Media Group — Manager Broadband Video

- Period: 02/2006–12/2007
- Location: Munich
- Website: https://www.prosiebensat1.com

Concept, licensing and launch of maxdome, one of the first major video-on-demand platforms in Germany, and set-up of the product management team.

## Education

- MBA, ESADE Business School, Barcelona, Spain (Class of 2013). One of the world's leading business schools. In the Financial Times Global MBA Ranking 2026, its Full-Time MBA ranks 7th worldwide and 5th in Europe, the second consecutive year in the top 10. ESADE holds triple accreditation (AACSB, EQUIS, AMBA), placing it among the small group of “Triple Crown” schools. https://www.esade.edu/mba
- Diplom-Wirtschaftsingenieur (Diploma in Business Engineering), Hochschule der Medien (HdM) Stuttgart, Germany (2006). Studies combining technology, media and business administration with two internship semesters. Final grade 1.8, thesis on the competition between the internet and TV for advertising budgets. https://www.hdm-stuttgart.de

## Key competencies

E-commerce, omnichannel retail, digital transformation, digital marketing, CRM, loyalty programs, change management, team building, D2C, B2B2C, marketplace strategy (Amazon, eBay, Kaufland), PIM/DAM, marketing technology, data-driven decision making, OKR/KPI frameworks, agile methods, pan-EU go-to-market, P&L responsibility, AI strategy.

## Questions and answers

### What does Alexander Kolisch do?

Alexander Kolisch is founder and managing partner of advise by Webmatch. He helps companies make digital initiatives deliver results, with sparring and context at management level, and has more than 20 years of experience as Chief Digital Officer, Director and Head of Digital.

### What is advise by Webmatch?

advise by Webmatch is the advisory practice of Webmatch GmbH and thus part of the Friends Digital Group. It supports management and digital leaders like a digital advisory board, with focus areas such as e-commerce, marketplaces, data, AI and organization.

### Which industries has Alexander Kolisch worked in?

In retail (Thalia, omnichannel retail), with manufacturers (SEVERIN, POSITEC/WORX), at media groups (Bertelsmann, ProSiebenSat.1, EMI) and in venture capital (Holtzbrinck Ventures). He also founded two ventures, including steereo, sold to a strategic buyer in 2011.

### What is Alexander Kolisch's educational background?

An MBA from ESADE Business School in Barcelona, ranked 7th in the Financial Times Global MBA Ranking and “Triple Crown” accredited, and a diploma in business engineering from Hochschule der Medien Stuttgart.

### How can I contact Alexander Kolisch?

Via the contact form on this page or via LinkedIn. Inquiries about advisory projects are handled through advise by Webmatch.

## Engagement

Volunteer at GuteNachtBus Düsseldorf, a project providing warm meals, drinks and conversation to homeless people in Düsseldorf. The bus stops at fixed points across the city in the evenings so guests know where to find it. It offers food, drinks and everyday essentials such as clothing and toiletries, but above all time for a conversation. https://gutenachtbus.de

### Stationen

#### advise by Webmatch (Joint Venture mit der Webmatch GmbH) — Gründer und Managing Partner (09/2026–heute)

advise by Webmatch bringt digitale Themen in Unternehmen zur Wirkung: mit Sparring, Einordnung und dem Blick von außen, wie ein digitaler Beirat am Tisch der Geschäftsführung. Schwerpunkte sind E-Commerce, Marktplätze, Daten, KI und die Organisation dahinter, gemessen mit einer eigenen Methodik aus advise Score, Kompass und Radar. advise ist Teil der Webmatch GmbH und damit der Friends Digital Group. Website: https://www.webmatch-advise.de

#### Polo Motorrad und Sportswear GmbH — Director E-Commerce und Marketing (08/2024–heute)

Verantwortung für E-Commerce, Marketing, CRM und Loyalty sowie den Kundenservice bei einem der führenden Omnichannel-Händler der Motorradbranche. Berichtslinie an Geschäftsführung und Gesellschafter, Führung eines Bereichs mit rund 40 Mitarbeitenden. Schwerpunkte: Weiterentwicklung von Webshop, CRM und Loyalty-Programm sowie Ausbau des Marktplatzgeschäfts. Dazu Themen wie Produktdaten, Automatisierung und die Organisation des Kundenservice. Website: https://www.polo-motorrad.com

#### SEVERIN Elektrogeräte GmbH — Director Marketing, Digital & E-Commerce (01/2021–07/2024)

Verantwortung für E-Commerce, Marketingbudgets und P&L mit Berichtslinie an Geschäftsführung und Gesellschafter. Internationale Einführung von PIM, DAM und Microsoft Teams, Ausgliederung der D2C-Logistik sowie Neuausrichtung von Corporate Identity und Markenauftritt. Dazu eine global aufgestellte B2B- und D2C-Strategie von Amazon Pan-EU über bol.com in den Niederlanden bis JD.com und Tmall in China, einschließlich Relaunch des eigenen EU-Webshops. Globale Einführung von PIM und DAM, agile Arbeitsweisen mit Scrum und Kanban sowie Leitung des DSGVO-Programms als EU-Ansprechpartner. Website: https://www.worx.com

Head of Digital beim größten Buchhändler im DACH-Raum mit Teams in Münster und Berlin. Produktverantwortung für die tolino-E-Reader-Familie mit vier Gerätestarts zwischen 2015 und 2016 sowie für Hörbuch- und E-Book-Abonnements. Website: https://www.thalia.de

#### Sporttsclub + fitback (Allianz Digital Accelerator) — Gründer und Geschäftsführer (01/2014–12/2016)

#### Bertelsmann SE — Director Corporate Development (07/2012–01/2014)

Director Corporate Development im Stab des Vorstands für Corporate Development und New Businesses. Mitarbeit an der Digitalstrategie des Konzerns sowie Bewertung und Umsetzung von Beteiligungen mit Schwerpunkt EdTech, Classifieds und Marktplätze. Website: https://www.bertelsmann.com

#### steereo (Trade Sale 2011) — Gründer, Geschäftsführer und Gesellschafter (11/2008–01/2011)

Gründer, Geschäftsführer und Gesellschafter eines mobilen Musik-Streamingdienstes mit kostenlosem und Abo-Modell, finanziert mit einem siebenstelligen Betrag von Holtzbrinck Ventures. Lizenzierung mit Major- und Independent-Labels sowie Verwertungsgesellschaften und erfolgreicher Verkauf an einen strategischen Käufer 2011.

#### EMI Music Germany — Manager Digital Experience (12/2007–04/2008)

Analyse der digitalen Reife und Strategieempfehlungen für ein 360-Grad-Modell. Umsetzung neuer digitaler Geschäftsinitiativen, etwa die Platzierung von EMI-Künstlern wie Iron Maiden in „Guitar Hero“.

#### ProSiebenSat.1 Media Group — Manager Broadband Video (02/2006–12/2007)

### Fragen und Antworten

#### Was macht Alexander Kolisch?

Alexander Kolisch ist Gründer und Managing Partner von advise by Webmatch. Er bringt digitale Themen in Unternehmen zur Wirkung, mit Sparring und Einordnung auf Ebene der Geschäftsführung, und hat mehr als 20 Jahre Erfahrung als Chief Digital Officer, Director und Head of Digital.

#### Was ist advise by Webmatch?

advise by Webmatch ist das Beratungsangebot der Webmatch GmbH und damit Teil der Friends Digital Group. Es begleitet Geschäftsführung und Digitalverantwortliche wie ein digitaler Beirat, mit Schwerpunkten wie E-Commerce, Marktplätze, Daten, KI und Organisation.

#### In welchen Branchen hat Alexander Kolisch gearbeitet?

Im Handel (Thalia, Omnichannel-Retail), bei Herstellern (SEVERIN, POSITEC/WORX), in Medienkonzernen (Bertelsmann, ProSiebenSat.1, EMI) und im Venture Capital (Holtzbrinck Ventures). Dazu kommen zwei eigene Gründungen, darunter steereo mit Verkauf an einen strategischen Käufer 2011.

#### Welche Ausbildung hat Alexander Kolisch?

Einen MBA der ESADE Business School in Barcelona, Platz 7 im Financial Times Global MBA Ranking und „Triple Crown“-akkreditiert, sowie ein Diplom als Wirtschaftsingenieur der Hochschule der Medien Stuttgart.

#### Wie erreicht man Alexander Kolisch?

Über das Kontaktformular auf dieser Seite oder über LinkedIn. Anfragen zu Beratungsprojekten laufen über advise by Webmatch.

### Ausbildung

- MBA, ESADE Business School, Barcelona (Class of 2013). Eine der führenden Business Schools weltweit. Im Financial Times Global MBA Ranking 2026 steht das Full-Time MBA auf Platz 7 weltweit und auf Platz 5 in Europa, das zweite Jahr in Folge in den Top 10. ESADE ist dreifach akkreditiert (AACSB, EQUIS, AMBA) und gehört damit zum kleinen Kreis der „Triple Crown“-Schulen. https://www.esade.edu/mba
- Diplom-Wirtschaftsingenieur an der Hochschule der Medien Stuttgart, ein Studium an der Schnittstelle von Technik, Medien und Betriebswirtschaft mit zwei Praxissemestern. Abschlussnote 1,8, Diplomarbeit über den Wettbewerb von Internet und TV um Werbebudgets. https://www.hdm-stuttgart.de

### Engagement

Ehrenamtliches Engagement beim GuteNachtBus Düsseldorf, einem Projekt, das obdachlose Menschen in Düsseldorf mit warmen Mahlzeiten, Getränken und Gesprächen versorgt. Der Bus fährt abends feste Haltestellen in der Stadt an, damit die Gäste wissen, wo sie ihn finden. Es gibt Essen, Getränke und Dinge des täglichen Bedarfs wie Kleidung und Hygieneartikel, vor allem aber Zeit für ein Gespräch. https://gutenachtbus.de
